newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY OFFERS BONDS, CERTIFICATES FOR AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: ITALY OFFERS BONDS, CERTIFICATES FOR AUCTION.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will issue three, five and 30-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) at its regular mid-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 13th tranche 15/5/97 3-yr BTPs paying a 6.0 percent coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on August 12.
Subscriptions for the auctions close at 1100 GMT on August 18. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
